ideas.title: Investigation into Federal Agent Shootings in Minnesota
ideas.description: A comprehensive investigation into the recent shootings by federal agents in Minnesota, including the circumstances surrounding the incidents and potential systemic issues within law enforcement agencies.
ideas.angle: Examining the use of force by federal agents and potential accountability issues
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shootings?
Are there systemic issues within law enforcement agencies that contributed to these incidents?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the recent shootings by federal agents in Minnesota, examining the use of force and potential accountability issues. It would involve analyzing public records, following the money, and conducting data analysis to identify patterns and potential systemic issues.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota

ideas.angle: Examining potential Medicaid fraud and systemic issues within the program
questions: What is the extent of potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Are there systemic issues within the Medicaid program that contributed to this fraud?
